cvStructure.issue: The Projects section includes a Physics II Lab Project about a transformer circuit, which is unrelated to the AI/Machine Learning target role and does not reinforce relevant technical skills.
cvStructure.suggestion: Consider removing the Physics II Lab Project or replacing it with another ML-related project to keep the section focused on skills relevant to an AI/ML Engineer role.

keywordUsage.issue: Power BI is listed under Tools, but no experience or project bullet mentions using it, so an ATS or recruiter cannot verify this skill from the content.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add a brief mention of how Power BI was used (for example, in the dashboard work during the internship) or remove it from the Tools list if it was not actually used.

keywordUsage.issue: Core target keywords such as 'Machine Learning' and 'Deep Learning' are demonstrated through projects but not explicitly listed in the Skills section.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add 'Machine Learning' and 'Deep Learning' as explicit skill keywords, since they are already shown through the ResNet-50 and scikit-learn work, to improve keyword matching for ML roles.

readability.issue: The summary is written in first person ('I enjoy...', 'I want to start...'), which is inconsistent with the more formal, achievement-focused tone used in the rest of the CV.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite the summary without personal pronouns, for example starting with 'Computer Science graduate with experience in...' to match the professional tone used in the Experience and Projects sections.

contentFormatting.issue: Dates are formatted inconsistently across sections: Education and most Projects show only a year, while Experience uses a full month-year range.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Use a consistent date format throughout, such as month and year for all entries, so Education, Experience, and Projects dates are easy for ATS systems to parse uniformly.
